## Summary

This is the `usememos/memos` Go backend. Derived/computed memo metadata is produced in two independent ways: **(A)** persisted "payload" fields (tags, content-property flags, extracted title) computed via a markdown-AST pass and stored on the memo row, and **(B)** an ephemeral "snippet"/excerpt computed on read (never persisted).

### A. Persisted derived metadata (tags, title, content-flags)

**Core extraction logic** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`
- `ExtractAll()` (lines 356-422) — single AST walk that computes, in one pass:
  - `Tags` (`#tag` nodes, deduplicated case-preserving) — lines 376-378, 418
  - `Property.Title` — derived from the **first H1 heading** if it's the first block-level node in the document — lines 383-389
  - `Property.HasLink` — presence of a markdown link — line 394
  - `Property.HasCode` — presence of code block/fenced code/code span — lines 396-397
  - `Property.HasTaskList` — presence of a task checkbox — lines 399-400
  - `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — an unchecked task checkbox — lines 401-404
  - `Mentions` (`@user` nodes, deduped) — lines 379-380, 419
  - (Equivalent standalone helpers also exist: `ExtractTags()` lines 143-170 and `ExtractProperties()` lines 193-241, but `ExtractAll` is what's actually used for the payload rebuild since it's more efficient.)

**Trigger / orchestration** — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`
- `RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, markdownService)` (lines 74-88): calls `markdownService.ExtractAll(memo.Content)` and assigns the result to `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.
- Invoked from:
  - `CreateMemo` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (on memo creation, before persisting)
  - `UpdateMemo` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (only when the `content` field is part of the update mask, i.e. content actually changed) — see lines 432-450
  - `Runner.RunOnce()` (same file, lines 27-72): a batch **background job** that re-lists all memos in pages of 100 and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for every one — used for one-off backfills/migrations (not currently wired into a recurring scheduler in `server.go`; other runners like `s3presignRunner` are invoked via `RunOnce(ctx)` at startup, but no cron currently calls the memopayload runner — it's available as a maintenance/backfill tool).

So recomputation happens **on create and on content-changing update**, plus optionally via an on-demand/batch **backfill job**, not on every read.

### B. On-read/on-render derived metadata (snippet)

**Computation** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`
- `GenerateSnippet(content, maxLength)` (lines 264-346): walks the AST, extracts plain text (skipping code blocks, converting tag nodes to `#tag`, autolinks to their URL), then truncates to `maxLength` at a word boundary (`truncateAtWord`, lines 472-489).

**Trigger** — computed **on read/render**, not stored:
- `getMemoContentSnippet(content)` wrapper — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90` (calls `GenerateSnippet(..., 64)`)
- Called every time a memo is converted to its API response in `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80`
- Also called when building related-memo snippets for `MemoRelation` responses — `memo_service_converter.go:225`, `248` (`batchConvertMemoRelations`), and for single-memo relation loading (`loadMemoRelations`, line 291)
- Also called for notification payloads (comment/mention emails or in-app notices) — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:318-391` (`memoNotificationSnippet`)

### Full list of extracted/computed properties
| Field | Computed by | Persisted? |
|---|---|---|
| `Tags` | `ExtractAll`/`ExtractTags` (`#tag` AST nodes) | Yes (`memo.Payload.Tags`) |
| `Property.Title` | First H1 heading text, only if it's the first block | Yes (`memo.Payload.Property.Title`) |
| `Property.HasLink` | Any markdown link present | Yes |
| `Property.HasCode` | Any code block/span present | Yes |
| `Property.HasTaskList` | Any task checkbox present | Yes |
| `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` | Any unchecked task checkbox | Yes |
| `Mentions` | `@user` AST nodes | Not persisted to `Payload` (used internally for mention notifications, see `memo_mention_helpers.go`) |
| `Snippet` | Plain-text excerpt, truncated to 64 chars at word boundary | No — computed fresh on every API response/notification build |

No word-count or reading-time computation exists in this codebase; the closest analog to "preview/excerpt" is the `Snippet` field, and the closest to "title derived from first line" is `Property.Title` (derived from the first H1 heading rather than literally the first line).</result>

content.text:
h14. Derived memo metadata is computed by the markdown service in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`, specifically the `ExtractAll` method (lines 356–412, single-pass version) plus the underlying `ExtractProperties` (lines 193–241) and `GenerateSnippet` (lines 264–333) methods. This service parses the memo's raw Markdown content with goldmark and walks the resulting AST.

**Computation site:** `internal/markdown/markdown.go` — `service.ExtractAll()` (and the standalone `ExtractProperties`/`GenerateSnippet` methods it mirrors). The results are assembled into `storepb.MemoPayload` fields by `RebuildMemoPayload()` in `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))` and writes `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.

**Triggers (recomputation):**
- `CreateMemo` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` calls `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` unconditionally whenever a new memo is created.
- `UpdateMemo` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, but only when `content` is present in the update mask (i.e., the memo's text actually changed); other field updates (visibility, pinned, state, etc.) don't trigger it.
- A batch backfill/maintenance path — `Runner.RunOnce()` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72` iterates all memos in pages of 100 and rebuilds+persists each payload via `Store.UpdateMemo`. This runner exists as reusable maintenance tooling but isn't currently wired into `server.go` startup (unlike e.g. the s3presign runner), so live recomputation today happens on create/content-update, not on a schedule.

**Extracted properties:**
- `Tags` — `#tag` occurrences found via AST tag nodes (excluding tags inside links/images).
- `Mentions` — `@username` occurrences (lowercased), collected in `ExtractedData.Mentions` (not persisted to `Payload` by `RebuildMemoPayload`, only used elsewhere).
- `Property.Title` — text of the document's first block if it's an H1 heading.
- `Property.HasLink` — true if any Markdown link exists.
- `Property.HasCode` — true if any code block/fenced code block/code span exists.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — true if any task checkbox exists.
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — true if any task checkbox is unchecked.
- Snippet (plain-text preview) — produced separately by `GenerateSnippet(content, maxLength)`, which walks the AST extracting text from paragraphs/headings/list items/table cells/autolinks/tags and truncates to `maxLength`, used for list/preview display rather than stored as a payload field.

content.text:
The background agent's findings confirm and slightly extend my answer — notably the on-read `Snippet` computation, which I hadn't included. Let me fold that in.

**Addendum to my h14 answer:** In addition to what I reported, there's a second, ephemeral category of derived metadata computed **on read/render** (not persisted):

- **Computation site:** `GenerateSnippet(content, maxLength)` in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:264-346`, wrapped by `getMemoContentSnippet()` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90`.
- **Trigger:** every time a memo (or a related memo) is converted to its API response — `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` in `memo_service_converter.go:76-80`, and for `MemoRelation` previews (`memo_service_converter.go:225,248,291`) — and when building notification payloads (`user_service_notifications.go:318-391`). So it recomputes on every list/preview render, not just on save.
- **Extracted property:** `Snippet` — a plain-text excerpt (code blocks skipped, tags rendered as `#tag`, autolinks resolved to URL) truncated to a max length at a word boundary.

So the full picture: `Tags` and `Property.{Title,HasLink,HasCode,HasTaskList,HasIncompleteTasks}` are computed once on create/content-update (or via the batch `RunOnce` backfill) and persisted to `memo.Payload`; `Snippet` is computed fresh on every read/render for lists and previews and is never stored.
